marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind northeast 15 knots diminishing to light this evening then
increasing to south 15 late overnight. Wind increasing to south 25 Friday
morning. Scattered flurries this morning overnight and Friday
morning. Temperatures minus 8 rising to minus 1 Friday
evening. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Outside the ice edge seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 near
noon Friday.<br/>
